title: DeployMocks asserts none of story 073's headline stream state, and the one probe that covers it is vacuous by construction
specText: Story 073 Verification line 544 (ticked): 'Confirm on the local chain: configs(1..5,7) resolve as expected, index 7 is a NudgeRatchet, all six donors' nudgeStreamer() return the streamer, and the three UniboostStaker* keys point at V2 instances holding the migrated totals.' Story 073 Autonomous Decision #8: 'TestNudgePayout was rewritten, and its stream assertions moved out of band.' Story 072 Preflight line 514 (UNTICKED): 'Confirm Kendu is not fee-on-transfer by round-tripping a non-zero amount through collectNudge.'
description: The script's 17 requires include no post-condition on `streams(batchMinter, token).duration == LOCAL_STREAM_DURATION`, on any buffer being non-zero, or on `pendingStream` accruing — the three facts story 073 exists to establish. Of the seven `setNudgeStreamer` calls only the SYA leg is post-asserted (:1129). The one probe touching stream state (:1661/:1664) runs solely against MockKendu and MockPhUSD, both fee-free by construction, so it cannot fail (see DEV-01).
impact: The story's reported outcome rests on console.log output rather than on-chain assertions, so a regression in the wiring would produce a green run. NOTE IN MITIGATION: the author's technical reason for not asserting accrual in-script is sound and documented at script/interactions/TestNudgePayout.s.sol:157-168 — a forge script's requires all execute in the simulation pass where every statement shares one block timestamp, so `pendingStream` reads 0 there regardless of the live chain. This is a genuine tooling constraint, not negligence. The gap is therefore in the RUNBOOK, not the script: nothing in the `dev` chain performs the out-of-band verification the author says is required.
attackPath: No attack path. The script's 17 requires include no post-condition on streams(batchMinter, token).duration, on any buffer being non-zero, or on pendingStream accruing - the three facts story 073 exists to establish. Of seven setNudgeStreamer calls only the SYA leg is post-asserted (:1129). The one probe touching stream state (:1661/:1664) runs solely against fee-free mocks and cannot fail (see DEV-01 case D).
evidence: This audit performed the missing verification with cast and confirmed all three self-reported numbers: duration == 21600 on all three tokens; buffers USDC 44855551 (44.855551, matching the reported '44.86'), phUSD 5000e18, Kendu 50000e18; pendingStream non-zero on all three; streamer ERC20 balance exactly equal to each credited buffer.
recommendation: Add the out-of-band verification to the `dev` chain as a scripted step (a `verify:streams` npm entry doing the cast reads and failing non-zero), so the property is enforced rather than documented. Post-assert all seven `setNudgeStreamer` calls, not just SYA. The same verification step is required in the mainnet runbook — see differential-gap.md §4.5.

severityRationale: LOW - HELD, not raised, but with its weight and fix priority explicitly escalated on the story-073 faithfulness re-run. The re-run was asked to consider a rise; here is the honest split. WHAT ROSE. (a) The finding's OTHER half - no post-condition on stream state and only 1 of 7 setNudgeStreamer calls post-asserted (:1129) - now has a story-level twin: checklist line 544 is TICKED while asserting 1 of its 4 clauses and 1 of its 7 legs (see FAITH-002). The code gap and the paper claim corroborate each other, which is materially stronger evidence than either alone. (b) Its vacuous-probe half is now DOUBLY supported: story 073 line 540's probe (DeployMocks.s.sol:1645-1666) runs against MockKendu, which story 073 line 496 itself defines as fee-free, AND story 072's Preflight line 514 - the real-token round-trip that would be genuine evidence - is UNTICKED. So the only two artefacts that could discharge the FoT obligation are respectively vacuous and undone. (c) It remains the express deferral venue for stable-yield-accumulator 5292756503 (M-02), whose 'fixed with knowingly-accepted residual' closure was granted on the basis that a forthcoming deploy-script audit would catch the remaining footguns - and the answer this run is 1 of 7. WHAT DID NOT RISE, and why. Severity must follow demonstrated impact. (1) A missing assertion is not itself an impact - the original rationale rejected Medium on exactly this principle and nothing in the re-run contradicts it. (2) The deployed state was INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED CORRECT this run by out-of-band cast reads (duration == 21600 on all three tokens; buffers USDC 44855551 / phUSD 5000e18 / Kendu 50000e18; pendingStream non-zero on all three; streamer ERC20 balance exactly equal to each credited buffer). There is no live defect for the missing assertion to be hiding. (3) The half that AD#8 covers - stream accrual moved out of band - got STRONGER, not weaker: AD#8 sanctions it and the underlying forge constraint (all requires execute in the simulation pass under one block timestamp, so pendingStream reads 0 regardless of chain state, documented at TestNudgePayout.s.sol:157-168) is a genuine tooling limit, not negligence. Raising severity on the strength of a corroborating PAPER finding, when the on-chain state is verified correct and half the gap is technically forced, would be exactly the overstatement this pipeline rejects. LOCAL-ONLY is unchanged. MANDATORY CARRY-FORWARD (unchanged and reaffirmed): a human must re-weigh whether stable-yield-accumulator 5292756503's `fixed` basis still holds, given that the mitigation its closure was deferred to post-asserts 1 of 7 setNudgeStreamer calls. No status is changed by this run. Per Law 1 this is parked in a visible channel.
severityAgreement: HELD AT LOW on re-weigh. Evidentiary weight and fix PRIORITY rise materially; severity does not, because a missing assertion is still not an impact.

reweigh.basis: Rise requested and DECLINED on severity; GRANTED on weight/priority. Corroborated by FAITH-002 (ticked line 544) and story 072's unticked line 514, but the on-chain state is verified correct and the accrual half is sanctioned by AD#8 under a genuine forge tooling constraint.
reweigh.priorityEscalation: HIGH - flaggedForReview. Two independent story-level corroborations plus the stable-yield-accumulator M-02 deferral make this the highest-priority Low in the set.

classifierNotes: Kept SEPARATE from DEV-01 (shares the vacuous-probe FACT, not the root cause; DEV-01 PROPAGATES-TO-MAINNET, DEV-09 is LOCAL-ONLY). ALSO KEPT SEPARATE FROM FAITH-002 - decision recorded explicitly because a merge was proposed and REJECTED. They share a subject (stream-state verification) but differ on all three collapse tests: ROOT CAUSE (DEV-09 = the .sol script omits post-conditions, partly for a documented and legitimate forge simulation-pass reason; FAITH-002 = the story .md certifies a manual confirmation that was not performed and left no evidence), FIX (DEV-09 = add a scripted `verify:streams` npm step and post-assert all seven setNudgeStreamer calls; FAITH-002 = untick line 544 or record the out-of-band evidence - a documentation-integrity action no code change discharges), and ARTIFACT/ROUTING (DEV-09 -> QA/Low bundle; FAITH-002 -> spec-conformance F-02, visible to the owner). Collapsing them would let a Law-2 false certification vanish into a code-gap QA note, which Law 2 forbids. Cross-linked both ways instead. CANONICAL HOME for the '1 of 7 post-asserted' fact remains DEV-09; DEV-03 and FAITH-002 carry it as cross-references only.

Constraint 2 forbids collapsing across that boundary, and collapsing would let a mainnet-propagating Medium be filed under a local-rig QA-shaped heading. parkedItemsCarriedForward.title: ERC4626YieldStrategy.previewRedeem / previewDeposit view passthroughs still STATICCALL the underlying vault — the story-060 / YS-01 Tokemak fix is one-directional
parkedItemsCarriedForward.sourceVerification: Read against the TOP-LEVEL submodule HEAD lib/reflax-yield-vault (not a nested stale pin). :73-75 `return vault.previewDeposit(assets);` and :83-85 `return vault.previewRedeem(shares);`, both declared `external view` => Solidity emits STATICCALL. Twenty lines below, :110-115 credits principal via `vault.convertToAssets(sharesReceived)` with an in-source comment naming the exact hazard: 'Use convertToAssets (NOT previewRedeem): convertToAssets is ERC4626-mandated STATICCALL-safe, whereas some real vaults (e.g. Tokemak Autopools) mutate state inside previewRedeem and revert with StateChangeDuringStaticCall when called as an external view.' The authors therefore knew the hazard and hardened ONE call site.
parkedItemsCarriedForward.whyItMatters: Against a real Tokemak Autopool these two views revert for every caller, always; against MockAutoDOLA (plain un-overridden OZ ERC4626) they return a clean number, always. The local rig therefore reports green on the exact behaviour that already bricked this project's YS-swap suite. Blast radius today is UI/keeper reads (no first-party on-chain caller found), which is why this is parked for triage rather than asserted as a Medium.

That acknowledgement does NOT cover previewRedeem/previewDeposit at :73-85, which are a different function and were never touched. This must not be auto-suppressed under 28d5044e4e.

parkedItemsCarriedForward.corroboratingMemory: stable-yield-accumulator run-14 note: 'the guard is ONE-DIRECTIONAL, residual paths reproduce'. Same shape, independently observed here.
secondaryGapsInTheSameMockSection: No maxRedeem/maxWithdraw check before `vault.redeem` in _disposeShares (:128-135): against a real Autopool with a liquid reserve below the request, user withdrawals brick. Locally impossible to reproduce.

MockAutoDOLA._updateYield() mints assets into the vault BEFORE super._deposit mints shares, so convertToAssets(sharesReceived) > amount and creditedPrincipal at :115 can EXCEED the deposited amount — the precise opposite of that line's stated intent. Any local invariant asserting 'principal is never over-credited' passes VACUOUSLY. Flagged because a vacuous-harness result is a known repeat failure mode in this repo.
parkedItemsCarriedForward.recommendedAction: Route to the script-auditor / code-scanner for a proper finding record with a fingerprint of its own (contract:function:StaticcallOnStateMutatingPreview:dev), or to /ledger for an explicit human decision. Do NOT fold into 28d5044e4e.
